race.comment: Open race to close out the card. The well-related HOT DIGITY BOOM (5) (half to G3 winner Charge) is a former Victorian who has been well in the betting in both local runs and strips fitter third-up from the break. Where there's smoke there's fire and watch for a spike in form. KIRIKAN (7) was a touch disappointing last time out but the form prior was full of merit. Capable of bouncing right back. BANCORY BAY (1) has gotten better with each run this campaign and is drawn to get all the favours from the inside alley. Top-three candidate. IMPRESSIONISM (2) saves his best form for this distance range and can improve on that first-up performance. In the mix. INSTA WORTHY (6) has been racing well in lesser grade and should be kept safe.
